title: Civic Center Plans, Police Funds, Utility Lawsuit
summary:
*   Reviewed an update on the ongoing Civic Center Project.
*   Discussed options to address a projected budget shortfall in the Police Department's operating funds.
*   Met privately to discuss potential land acquisitions, personnel matters, and pending litigation, including a lawsuit against Houston Lighting and Power Company.

Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the City Council, noting the presence of all
Councilmembers.
Council held worksession on Gilbane Update on the Civic Center Project and Consider
Options to Address Projected Shortfall in the Police Department 1987-88 Operating Budget.
EXECUTIVE SESSION Mayor Cooksey announced Council would go into executive session pursuant
to Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated to discuss matters of land
acquisition, litigation, and for personnel matters. No final action, decision or vote by
the City Council will be taken on any subject or matter unless specifically listed on the
agenda for this meeting.
1. Pending Litigation - Section 2, Paragraph e a. City of Austin v. Houston Lighting and
Power Company RECESS AND ADJOURNMENT Council recessed its meeting at 4:47 p.m. for
executive session and resumed its regular meeting for adjournment at 5:35 p.m.
No action was taken on any other items on the agenda.
